title: Choose the visual direction for Serbify
question: The roll assigned Manila Price-Tag & Counter Board. Keep it, take Impeccable's Pick, take the category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Manila Price-Tag & Counter Board
options.lineage: Filipino neighborhood hardware counter & printed price-tag boards
options.thesis: Upfront home-service pricing and verified pros presented like a crisp neighborhood service counter—warm, plain-spoken, and impossible to misread.
options.viewport: Warm paper canvas with bold plain-English headline, an interactive service & price-check bar (Locksmith, Plumbing, Electrical, Aircon from ₱80), and a verified pro arrival preview.
options.risk: Can feel cluttered if price tags and checklist rows are not given generous breathing room.

raised.raise: Booking journey moves through fixed, unmistakable linear stations in order.
Selected services and completed steps invert decisively with zero ambiguity.
Step numbers and checklists sit in a strict, aligned margin column.
Job-done proof photos appear as an honest, inspectable frame strip.
One dominant focal anchor per screen instead of competing cards.
Strict typographic hierarchy from display headline down to tabular peso numerals.

options.label: Barangay Service Directory
options.lineage: Printed barangay service directory & condo lobby reception board
options.thesis: A calm, editorial service directory built around clear rate tables, ID-verified pro profiles, and step-by-step arrival tracking.
options.viewport: Editorial split opening with plain-spoken headline, live service rate selector, and a clean verified-pro booking card.
options.risk: Closer to familiar service directories; also where most runs in this category land.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight Bay
options.risk: Too dark and mysterious for letting a repair pro into your home.
options.case: Fuses poorly: homeowners want bright clarity and trust, not darkroom mood.

options.label: One-Bit Desktop
options.risk: Reads as retro tech nostalgia rather than everyday home help.

options.label: Orizuru Crane Sequence
options.viewport: Numbered fold sequence in strict margin.
options.risk: Origami motif has no natural link to Filipino home repairs.
options.case: Fuses poorly: wrong cultural and functional metaphor.
options.kept: Strict numbered margin column for steps.

options.label: Hand-Processed 16mm Film
options.risk: Scratches and grain feel damaged instead of reliable.
options.case: Fuses poorly: home repair needs clean proof, not distressed film.

options.label: Polish Film Poster
options.viewport: Full-bleed surreal painting with bent title.
options.case: Fuses poorly: homeowners need clear prices and IDs, not surrealism.
options.kept: Single dominant focal anchor per screen.

options.label: Emigre Bitmap Specimen
options.viewport: Poster-scale pixel headlines over dense columns.
options.risk: Low-res bitmap type hurts price and safety legibility.
options.case: Fuses poorly: feels like a design zine rather than a consumer app.
options.kept: Strict typographic hierarchy across size steps.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean white-and-blue app showcase with centered headline, phone mockup, and feature cards.
canonCard.viewport: Standard consumer app hero with phone frame and store badges.
canonCard.risk: Looks like most other on-demand service landing pages.
